description:
### **About Us**


Power Bridge is a customer centric AV \& IT Infrastructure Solution \& Services Provider, pivoting to bridge the Gap between innovative IT products, solutions and Customer needs.  

  



With Offices in Bangalore (HQ) and Hyderabad, we boast the capabilities and operational excellence to execute projects for our customers across India.  

  



Our Passionate teams across business functions work in tandem with our Industry leading Technology partners to deliver hassle\-free technology upgrades projects with time bound SLA’s.  

  



### **Job Description**


We are seeking an experienced Server Administrator to manage and support our core virtualization, backup, automation, cloud, identity, and endpoint security platforms. The role is responsible for maintaining high availability, ensuring data protection, supporting compliance requirements, and integrating on\-premises infrastructure with cloud\-based systems. The ideal candidate should have a strong infrastructure administration background, hands\-on experience with enterprise technologies, an automation\-oriented mindset, and the ability to support internal and external audits.  

  



  

  

### **Requirements**


**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Administer and maintain Nutanix and HPE SimpliVity virtualization infrastructure.
* Monitor server health, performance, capacity, availability, and resource utilization.
* Provision and manage virtual machines, storage, clusters, upgrades, and infrastructure configurations.
* Manage Acronis Backup, including backup policies, schedules, retention, replication, recovery, and restore testing.
* Monitor backup jobs and resolve failures to ensure compliance with defined RPO and RTO requirements.
* Administer Active Directory, including users, groups, organizational units, Group Policies, DNS, DHCP, and access permissions.
* Support Microsoft Azure services and integration between Azure and on\-premises environments.
* Manage server security, patching, hardening, access controls, antivirus, and vulnerability\-remediation activities.
* Administer BitLocker encryption and maintain encryption and recovery\-key compliance.
* Manage SCCM and PDQ Deploy for software distribution, patch management, inventory, and endpoint administration.
* Support and manage the organization’s email security gateway, including filtering policies and troubleshooting mail\-flow issues.
* Develop and maintain workflow automation using Microsoft Power Automate.
* Manage and support secure bank SFTP integrations, including file\-transfer monitoring, access control, encryption, and troubleshooting.
* Monitor infrastructure alerts and respond to server, backup, application, and security incidents.
* Maintain technical documentation, asset records, configuration details, SOPs, and disaster\-recovery procedures.
* Participate in business continuity and disaster\-recovery planning, testing, and reporting.
* Support internal and external audits by providing system evidence, access records, patching reports, backup reports, and compliance documentation.
* Coordinate with vendors, service providers, application teams, security teams, and business stakeholders.
* Identify opportunities to automate routine administrative activities and improve operational efficiency.
* Provide support during planned maintenance, critical incidents, and infrastructure upgrades when required.

**Required Technical Skill Set**
--------------------------------

* Strong administration experience with Windows Server environments.
* Hands\-on experience with Nutanix and HPE SimpliVity.
* Experience managing Acronis Backup and performing system restoration.
* Strong knowledge of Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS, DHCP, and identity administration.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft Azure and hybrid cloud environments.
* Experience with Microsoft Power Automate.
* Knowledge of secure SFTP integration, preferably involving banking or financial systems.
* Experience managing BitLocker encryption.
* Hands\-on experience with SCCM and PDQ Deploy.
* Experience with email security gateways and email\-flow troubleshooting.
* Knowledge of server hardening, patch management, vulnerability remediation, antivirus, and endpoint security.
* Understanding of backup concepts, disaster recovery, RPO, RTO, and business continuity.
* Experience supporting internal and external IT audits.
* Familiarity with IT compliance controls, evidence collection, access reviews, and change management.
* Working knowledge of PowerShell or similar scripting tools will be an advantage.
Knowledge of networking fundamentals, including TCP/IP, VLANs, routing, firewalls, VPNs, and ports.  
*

• Long\-term benefit savings plan with employer matching contributions.
  

• Opportunities for professional development and advancement within the organization.

At UKG, the work you do matters. The code you ship, the decisions you make, and the care you show a customer all add up to real impact. Role Overview
  

UKG ESE organization is seeking an experienced Product Owner – Salesforce Customer Experience (CX) to drive the strategy, prioritization, and delivery of customer\-facing capabilities across the Salesforce platform, with a primary focus on Salesforce Service Cloud and Experience Cloud. The ideal candidate will combine strong Salesforce platform knowledge with a deep understanding of Customer Support and digital customer experience processes. This role will serve as the bridge between business stakeholders, customers, engineering, architecture, and other product teams to translate business needs into scalable product capabilities and measurable business outcomes.
  

The Product Owner will own and prioritize the product backlog, shape solution direction, define requirements and acceptance criteria, and partner closely with cross\-functional teams to deliver intuitive, scalable, and high\-value customer and agent experiences.
  

Key Responsibilities
  

* Product Ownership \& Strategy: Own the product vision, roadmap, and backlog for assigned Salesforce CX capabilities across Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, and related customer support solutions, ensuring alignment with business objectives, customer needs, and enterprise technology strategy.
* Roadmap \& Prioritization: Develop and continuously manage the product backlog by evaluating business value, customer impact, dependencies, risks, and delivery effort. Make informed prioritization recommendations and clearly communicate trade\-offs to stakeholders.
* Customer \& Business Advocacy: Develop a strong understanding of customer, support\-agent, and business\-user journeys. Identify pain points and opportunities to simplify processes, improve self\-service, increase agent productivity, and enhance the overall customer experience.
* Requirements \& User Stories: Translate business objectives and customer needs into clear product requirements, epics, features, user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, and measurable outcomes that engineering teams can successfully execute.
* Stakeholder Management: Build and maintain strong relationships with global and regional business stakeholders, Customer Support teams, Product Management, Engineering, Architecture, Operations, and other cross\-functional teams.
* Discovery \& Solution Definition: Lead discovery sessions, workshops, process reviews, and solution discussions to understand business problems and define scalable solutions. Challenge requirements where appropriate and focus on solving the underlying business or customer problem.
* Salesforce Solution Leadership: Partner with Salesforce architects and engineering teams to define solutions that leverage Salesforce capabilities and best practices, with an emphasis on configuration and out\-of\-the\-box capabilities before customization.
* Agile Delivery: Serve as the primary product representative within the Agile delivery team. Participate in backlog refinement, sprint planning, daily collaboration, demos, retrospectives, and release planning while ensuring the team has clear priorities and requirements.

* Strong administration and troubleshooting on Linux (RHEL, CentOS, Ubuntu) systemd, journald, permissions, process and resource analysis, package management
* Windows Server administration — services, Event Viewer, registry, PowerShell, IIS, performance monitoring
* Working knowledge of Solaris or another commercial UNIX in a legacy enterprise context
* Shell scripting (Bash, PowerShell)

* Practical understanding of TLS/PKI, certificate management and common certificate failure modes

**Networking**
--------------

* Solid grounding in TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, routing, NAT, firewalls, load balancers and proxies
* Ability to read and interpret packet captures (Wireshark, tcpdump) to isolate connectivity and latency issues

**Development**
---------------

* Proficient in Python for automation, tooling and data processing
* Comfortable with Git, code review and CI/CD pipelines
* Ability to read unfamiliar production code and trace a fault to its source

**Database**
------------

* Strong SQL against at least one of SQL Server, PostgreSQL, Oracle or MySQL
* Query performance analysis, indexing, execution plans, backup/restore, and basic administration

**Cloud**
---------

* Working knowledge of at least one major cloud platform (Azure, AWS or GCP) — compute, networking, identity, storage and managed database services

=============

 **POSITION PURPOSE:**



The CRM Customer Data Steward is a hands\-on business data stewardship role responsible for ensuring that customer data in CRM is trusted, complete, well\-structured, governed, and ready for commercial use, analytics, automation, and AI\-enabled customer engagement. The role focuses on improving the quality and usability of CRM customer data across markets, platforms, and customer\-facing processes.



This role owns the day\-to\-day stewardship routines for CRM customer data, including business definitions, metadata, data quality checks, issue triage, remediation follow\-up, glossary management, and process documentation. The role is forward\-looking and automation\-minded. It does not only maintain CRM data; it continuously improves how CRM processes work. This includes identifying manual steps, recurring data quality issues, duplicate work, approval bottlenecks, exception handling gaps, and reporting friction — then translating these into practical improvements, workflow automation opportunities, AI\-enabled support, and scalable stewardship practices.



As CRM becomes more connected with customer engagement, commercial execution, analytics, and AI, this role strengthens the data foundation needed for better decisions and better customer interactions. * Direct ownership of a client relationship, not a back\-seat delivery role

Job Description – IT Administrator

**Job Title:** IT Administrator  
**Department:** IT / Administration  
**Location:** Bengaluru  
**Employment Type:** Full\-time  
**Reporting To:** Head of Operations / HR / Management

About the Role

We are looking for a hands\-on **IT Administrator** to manage and support the company’s day\-to\-day IT infrastructure, systems, devices, user access, and IT security.

The ideal candidate should be comfortable working in a fast\-paced startup environment and should be able to independently troubleshoot issues, manage IT assets, coordinate with vendors, and ensure employees have the required systems and access to perform their work efficiently.

Key Responsibilities1\. IT Infrastructure \& Support

* Manage day\-to\-day IT operations and provide technical support to employees.
* Troubleshoot hardware, software, network, Wi\-Fi, printer, and other IT\-related issues.
* Maintain office IT infrastructure including routers, switches, access points, printers, UPS, and other equipment.
* Monitor system and network performance and coordinate with service providers when required.
* Maintain proper documentation of IT infrastructure, configurations, and vendors.

2\. Laptop \& IT Asset Management

* Manage the complete lifecycle of company laptops, desktops, monitors, peripherals, and other IT assets.
* Maintain an updated IT asset inventory and asset allocation records.
* Configure and deploy laptops and systems for new employees.
* Ensure proper collection, inspection, and secure wiping of devices during employee exits.
* Coordinate repairs, warranty claims, AMC, and replacement of IT equipment.
* Implement appropriate controls to prevent loss or misuse of company assets.

3\. User \& Access Management

* Create, modify, and deactivate employee accounts and system access.
* Manage access to email, Google Workspace/Microsoft 365, Slack, HRMS, cloud applications, and other business tools.
* Ensure access is provided based on role and business requirements.
* Immediately revoke access for employees leaving the organisation.
* Conduct periodic access reviews and maintain proper access records.

4\. IT Security

* Implement and maintain basic IT security controls across company systems.
* Ensure laptops and systems have appropriate antivirus/endpoint protection and security updates.
* Support password, MFA, device security, and access\-control practices.
* Monitor and report suspicious activities, security incidents, or unauthorised access.
* Work with external cybersecurity vendors/consultants when required.
* Conduct periodic security awareness initiatives for employees.

5\. Vendor \& Service Provider Management

* Coordinate with internet service providers, hardware vendors, software vendors, and IT support partners.
* Evaluate quotations and assist with procurement of IT equipment and software.
* Track IT contracts, AMC, warranties, subscriptions, and renewals.
* Ensure timely resolution of vendor\-related issues.

6\. IT Policies \& Documentation

* Develop and maintain IT policies, SOPs, and guidelines.
* Maintain records for IT assets, software licenses, user access, and IT incidents.
* Support implementation of company policies related to information security and acceptable use of IT resources.
* Assist HR and management during employee onboarding and offboarding.

7\. Backup \& Business Continuity

* Ensure appropriate backup processes are implemented for critical company data and systems.
* Periodically verify backup availability and restoration processes.
* Support disaster recovery and business continuity planning.

Onboarding \& Offboarding

The IT Administrator will work closely with **HR and department heads** to ensure:

**Employee Onboarding**

* Laptop/system allocation
* Email and application account creation
* Access provisioning
* Basic IT orientation
* Asset acknowledgement

**Employee Offboarding**

* Disable all user accounts and access
* Recover laptops and IT assets
* Transfer/secure company data
* Revoke application and cloud access
* Update asset and access records

Requirements

* Bachelor's degree/diploma in IT, Computer Science, or a related field.
* **2–5 years of experience** in IT administration, IT support, or system administration.
* Strong knowledge of Windows/macOS operating systems.
* Good understanding of networking, Wi\-Fi, VPN, DNS, DHCP, and troubleshooting.
* Experience with Google Workspace or Microsoft 365\.
* Experience in laptop/device and IT asset management.
* Basic understanding of cybersecurity and endpoint security.
* Good vendor\-management and communication skills.
* Ability to work independently and resolve issues quickly.

Preferred Skills

* Experience with an early\-stage/startup environment.
* Experience managing cloud\-based applications and SaaS tools.
* Knowledge of MDM solutions such as Google Endpoint Management, Microsoft Intune, Jamf, or similar.
* Basic knowledge of cloud platforms such as AWS/Azure/GCP.
* Familiarity with IT security frameworks and best practices.
* Experience implementing IT policies and access\-control processes.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* IT issues resolved within defined timelines.
* System and network uptime.
* Accurate IT asset inventory.
* Timely onboarding/offboarding access management.
* Timely renewal of IT licenses and subscriptions.
* Reduction in recurring IT issues.
* Compliance with IT security policies.
* Employee satisfaction with IT support.

What We’re Looking For

We are looking for someone who is **hands\-on, proactive, organised, security\-conscious, and comfortable taking ownership** of the company's IT operations. The person should be able to work independently, prioritise multiple requests, and build scalable IT processes as the organisation grows.

-------------------


G2 is looking for a Salesforce Engineer based in Bangalore, India to serve as the primary technical partner embedded with our sales and revenue\-facing business stakeholders, someone who can move fluidly from a conversation about pipeline OKRs to writing Apex code to shipping a solution in production.
